scope: Post-test diagnosis only; exploratory grouping, not a new selection rule, hyperparameter search or causal ablation
validation_design: One official H-step suffix per selected series, at most 128 uniformly seeded series; repeatedly used for context, learning rate and checkpoint selection

largest_regression_cpu_mps_reproduction.scope: Post-completion read-only reproduction of largest CRPS regression; no weights or selections changed

evidence_limits: Repeated single-suffix validation is a plausible selection-overfitting mechanism, not an experimentally isolated cause.
Training uses context caps and a history-scaled 21-quantile objective; testing uses full-context official-default forecasts and nine-quantile CRPS/MASE. Mismatch is a hypothesis, not a proven defect.
One-seed test results do not establish statistical significance or characterize all training variability.
Do not replace a frozen adapter using this observed test result and claim an independent leaderboard improvement.
